title: Last Stand
tagline: One soldier. 1500 zones. Hold the line.
description: Auto-fire top-down zombie defense. Use towers, barrels and machine guns, kill the boss, extract, gear up in the Store, and beat level 1500 to Prestige.

title: Color Magic
description: A dumpster-and-conveyor color sorter. Release color stacks onto the track and catch every piece in a matching dumpster before the loop jams.

title: Dealer Wars
tagline: Buy low. Fix 'em up. Sell high.
description: Run a used car lot. Bid at auctions, haggle with sellers, fix up beaters, hunt rare classics, and grow a gravel lot into an auto mall. Just don't owe Big Tony.
